# Upstream commits manually verified as already incorporated into this
# fork's main, despite having no title match (the heuristic
# upstream-check.yml's default check relies on). Content was independently
# confirmed present — via a differently-titled local commit, an
# architecture that already supersedes what the commit adds, or the change
# being moot after a later migration (e.g. a framework swap) — by reading
# the actual diffs, not just comparing titles. See each entry's comment for
# the specific reason; see CLAUDE.md for the general methodology.
#
# Format: one full 40-char commit SHA per line, `#` starts a comment,
# blank lines ignored. upstream-check.yml skips any SHA listed here.
#
# Two kinds of entry live here, and the distinction matters:
#
#   1. INCORPORATED — the content is present, verified by reading the diffs.
#      Add one only after actually checking, because this file silences the
#      daily check for that commit forever and a wrong entry would hide a
#      real gap.
#
#   2. DECLINED — the content is deliberately NOT being taken, because this
#      fork has made a different product or architectural choice. These are
#      not gaps; they are decisions. They were held out of this file for a
#      while precisely so they would keep alerting, but an alert that fires
#      daily on a settled decision trains you to ignore the alert, which
#      costs more than it saves. Each one below records what was decided and
#      what would have to change to revisit it.

# All of the following are pre-existing sendLightning/finalize
# instrumentation and leak-guard tuning against the OLD synchronous xpay
# implementation. This fork's sendLightning is fire-and-forget
# (completeLightningInBackground in lib/payments.ts), which already
# contains equivalent or superior verification/leak-guard logic. Verified
# by reading completeLightningInBackground's current implementation
# against each of these patches' stated intent.
9fca61790af069dc150a6923c89d119c537e512c # sendLightning / sendKeysend: only reverse when CLN reports the payment failed
b8e194affb096af2468624c4863803c7fa406b6e # log when listpays verification itself errors
fe767002dd59f000d54fd09c9d617d69b9a5c894 # tighten LEAKED DEBIT guard: don't false-alarm on successful-via-fallback paths
cb0f1962238534ce0fa2261373a018bf34a868f5 # sendLightning: silence success-case xpay log, re-read db before leak guard
caebad1dd85188f4315751c6ce77f92d7a1588c2 # sendLightning: stop warning on healthy multi-path payments

# Landed as a split, not a single pick — d8a361bd bundles eight changes, each
# verified individually before this entry was added:
#   admin surface   -> f3ec4c5a, then taken further than upstream: GET /users,
#                      POST /freeze, POST /reset, POST /forgot,
#                      POST /admin/sanitize-images and the config.adminpass
#                      master password are all gone, the operator edits redis
#                      over ssh instead. The "deliberately KEPT" divergence
#                      this file used to record no longer applies.
#   redactBody      -> superseded by 1e3b27c6, which removed request/response
#                      file logging altogether rather than redacting it
#   requireAccount  -> 94340f38   build receipt -> de621330
#   xpay retry_for  -> differently shaped here (retryFor = whitelisted ? 30
#                      : 60, already present); the coupled half, check()'s
#                      2x reversal window, landed in 483e2fc1
#   ecash SSRF      -> a5896c75 / safe-fetch;  melt amount guard -> ad78d164
#   /sign ownership -> present in routes/invoices.ts sign()
#   webhook TLS     -> a5896c75    liquid kill switch -> lib/invoices.ts
#   elements pin    -> c3232c36 (checksum re-verified against the published
#                      SHA256SUMS, not taken on trust from the patch)
#   assertNameFree  -> MOOT here: it stops an account taking a name the v3
#                      registrar holds, which matters only because lnurl.ts
#                      resolves a claimed name ahead of the local account.
#                      That deferral is opt-in on NAMES_URL, and this fork has
#                      no v3 — NAMES_URL is set nowhere, so registrarLookup()
#                      always returns null and no name can be misdirected.
#                      If this fork ever joins a v3 registrar, the guard has
#                      to be written before NAMES_URL is set.
d8a361bdcfaa8cc5b39d9675e74b0e1d2e42be2c # security: drop the admin endpoint surface and land pending hardening

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- DECLINED
# Deliberately not taken. Silenced on the operator's instruction 2026-09-24,
# after each had been alerting daily since the sync pass that deferred it.
# Revisit only if the note says the reason has lapsed.

# Upstream is RETIRING the fund mechanism outright: deposit, /take and
# /authorize all refuse unconditionally. This fork uses funds actively — gift
# links and the lnurlw withdraw flow — and has taken its own fund code
# further than upstream's in the opposite direction: 28701118 fixed take()
# consuming an authorization before authorizing the caller, and 352959c2 made
# a managed fund visible only to its managers. Taking this would delete a
# live feature. Revisit only if funds are being retired here too.
d128ee51c292c331ea1f26d745a5fc280fb3f439 # funds: close deposits, withdrawals and authorizations

# Architectural rewrite of lib/ecash.ts + routes/ecash.ts. Changes /claim
# semantics and removes routes, so it is a redesign to adopt deliberately,
# not a patch to merge. This fork's ecash path has since diverged anyway
# (keyset-based ext() in 78d4c0af, the mint-URL SSRF fix, ecashEnabled
# gating). Revisit as a planned piece of work, not as a sync item.
c72fa2a5ccf1cc04073f9ff12606491971dadd36 # ecash: redeem tokens by melting to the user's own invoice

# fix. Its lib/payments.ts hunks conflict with clnPartsAllFailed, this fork's

# resolution against whatever payments.ts looks like then.
